systems.owner: National Identity Card Unit, under the Prime Minister's Office
systems.tiers: offices designated by the Head of the Unit; registration, personalisation and issuance of the identity card and Mobile ID

systems.owner: Head of the National Identity Card Unit
systems.tiers: kept in electronic form at an office the Minister designates; records the identity particulars of every citizen

systems.country_label: Mobile ID, stored in the digital wallet
systems.tiers: optional for holders of an identity card, from 19 February 2024

note: The identity card law: the card is applied for at 18 on a birth certificate, the Head of the Unit consults the Registrar of Civil Status and cancels a card on registration of death; nothing on how a birth or death is registered.
